title: RunTestPayload
description: Payload for the RUN_TEST command (see contracts/enums/enums.yaml). Delivered to the device via GET /api/v1/devices/{device_id}/command and inflated by test-control immediately before the device's logger state transitions PREPARING -> RUNNING_TEST.

test_id.description: ULID-prefixed test identifier. Server-assigned. Recorded in header.json and joined onto every Parquet row.

server_host.description: Hostname or IP literal the UE connects to / sends to for every flow in this test. A single host per test; per-flow distinction is by port (see TestPlan.flows[].server_port).

logging_config_override.description: Optional per-test override applied on top of the device's currently effective LoggingConfig. The override is the intersection-with-capability rule applied at resolve_effective_config() time (invariant 3). Schema definition pending — capability + LoggingConfig schemas are not yet authored.
